mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Fireman's Park and a Waning Gibbous moon to look forward to tonight. You can also catch the International Space Station passing overhead at 8:38 PM for three minutes, traveling from over Mount Horeb toward Belleville.

The Verona Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to discuss various development projects, including site plans for 201 South Main Street. Additionally, the city has been busy with new sculptures at Century School Park and ongoing progress on the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan.

We have a full slate of activities starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and look forward to the downtown farmer's market, live music, and more events throughout the week.
In our weekly report, on September 21, officers were dispatched for a retail theft at a business on East Verona Avenue where an individual was identified via surveillance video.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently open, so be sure to stop by before they close at 10 PM tonight.
